note: Deployed addresses per chain. The worker reads these; they are safe to commit because SpinAssignment is immutable, so an address and its ABI can never drift apart. A new version means a new address recorded here, resolved through SpinRegistry.

8453.name: base-mainnet

SpinAssignment.note: v2. Replaces 0x6Bb0d32d... which had a checks-effects-interactions violation in commitStage1/commitBatch (external VRF call before the state write). Rolled over through SpinRegistry, which is exactly what the registry exists for. Nothing was bound to v1, so nothing had to migrate.

outstanding: Deploy SpinAssignment v3 (src/SpinAssignment.sol at this commit) with script/DeployUpgrade.s.sol from a deployer that is NOT the operator key, and make it the registry default. See clubzapi/SPIN_WORKER_DEPLOY.md, 'Rolling over to SpinAssignment v3'.
Add v3 as a VRF consumer; remove v1.

Create a Safe. Run script/TransferRoles.s.sol with SPIN_NEW_OPERATOR (a fresh, funded key), SPIN_NEW_OWNER=<safe> and SPIN_SUPERSEDED_ASSIGNMENTS=<v1>, against v2, then SPIN_NEW_OWNER against v3; the Safe accepts ownership of each.

Point SPIN_ASSIGNMENT_ADDRESS at v3 and SPIN_OPERATOR_PRIVATE_KEY at the new operator on BOTH spinworker and clubzapi. SPIN_REGISTRY_ADDRESS is required: the worker binds every contest before stage 1.
Reveal the salts of the two COMMITTED contests past lock; abandon the seven SEEDED ones from the Safe.
Record the v3 address here once deployed and verified.

SpinAssignment_v1_superseded.note: SUPERSEDED, do not use. Still approved in the registry so any contest bound to it could settle, but none ever was.

SpinAssignment_v3.note: Not yet deployed. Fixes WebThree H-07 (immutable VRF coordinator, owner != operator enforced, registry binding enforced at stage 1, finalize in commit order) and M-08 (capacity reserved at commit, duplicate entry ids rejected, stuck head batches voidable after a day, SEEDED contests abandonable only after three days). ABI keeps every v2 function; the constructor takes the registry address.
